title: User Rules
description: Hard rules from the player. The bot must ALWAYS obey these; they override any strategy or task.

rules.rule: Never tap real-money purchase buttons (e.g. '$61.90', 'TOP UP NOW', monthly cards, first-purchase promos). Only close such popups with their X.
rules.reason: Free-to-play account. Spending real money is never allowed.

rules.rule: Never, under any circumstances, tap the 'Finish' button (the one that costs gems/diamonds) to complete troop training. Only 'Speedups' (accelerators) and 'Train' are allowed on troop buildings.
rules.reason: Gems are premium currency; the player forbids spending them to finish training.

rules.rule: All code, comments, docstrings, terminal messages, task names, filenames and identifiers are in English.
rules.reason: Project language decided by the user.

rules.rule: Crop image templates ONLY from ADB captures at 540x960, never from the BlueStacks window screenshots.
rules.reason: The BlueStacks window uses a different scale, so those templates would not match.

rules.rule: If the bot cannot advance a forced tutorial step on its own, it must stop and ask the user to complete that action, then continue automatically.
rules.reason: Requested behavior: prefer a generic approach and ask for help instead of guessing risky taps.

rules.rule: Show durations in a friendly way: seconds under 60s, minutes from 60s to under 1h, hours from 60min on (e.g. '45s', '10min', '2h 15min').
